Link Area-Restricted Phase (ARP) Clusters

Source: R/link.arp.R
link.arp.Rd

Merges temporally close Area-Restricted Phase (ARP) clusters and movement gaps based on a specified temporal threshold using graph components from igraph.

Usage

link.arp(data, thres = 0, time.col = "time", id.col = "ID")

Arguments

data

An object of class disperseR containing movement data and ARP cluster definitions.

thres

Numeric. Temporal gap threshold (in seconds) below which adjacent ARP clusters will be linked. Default is 0.

time.col

Character. Name of the column containing timestamp or date-time values. Default is "time".

id.col

Character. Name of the column containing individual identifiers. Default is "ID".

Value

An updated object of class disperseR containing linked cluster IDs and associated graph network structures under cluster_graphs.

Examples

eps <- get.epsilon(sim_states)
#> Computing a global threshold using all data combined.
arp <- get.arp(sim_states, epsilon = eps, delta.days = 2, pct.state1 = 0.2)
# Link ARP clusters separated by less than 24 hours
linked <- link.arp(arp, thres = 24 * 3600)
table(linked$data$ID, linked$data$linked_clusters)
#>      
#>       arp_1 arp_2 arp_3 arp_4 mov_1 mov_3 mov_5 mov_7
#>   F02   194    72   218   145    55    46    24    72
#>   F04   649     0     0     0    54    72    58     0
#>   F05   159     0     0     0   161   129     0     0
#>   M01   551   303     0     0    63   103    72    95
#>   M03   171   193     0     0    55    74     0     0
